product_name: cooked grey shrimp non-deheaded jumbo msc s-at
summary: Cooked grey shrimp non-deheaded jumbo MSC S-AT is being recalled from Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Occitanie, Pays-de-la-Loire, and Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur due to the presence of Listeria monocytogenes, which can cause listeriosis; severe forms may include neurological complications and maternal or fetal impacts. Consumers who have consumed these products and are experiencing fever, headaches, muscle aches, or other symptoms should consult their general practitioner. Do not consume the product and contact customer service for further instructions.
consumer_action: Do not consume the product and contact customer service for further instructions. Consumers who have consumed the 'products' mentioned above and are experiencing fever, either alone or accompanied by headaches and muscle aches, are advised to consult their general practitioner, informing them of this consumption.
